note: Universal Event for engine state transitions. Mutating events always include law_version and reason. ACB Subjects never appear as object_ids of self.

fields.event_type: string — transition class (order_applied, lot_minted, law_enacted, claim_pressed, production_tick, exchange, raid, siege, plant, kinship, season_resolved, …)
fields.season: int|null — Bandua season index when applicable
fields.object_ids: string[] — STRATA Object ids touched (castro, lots)
fields.verb: string — finite verb from verb registry
fields.before: object — snapshot slice prior to transition
fields.law_version: string — HearthLaw / Grove policy version at apply time
fields.causes: string[] — prior event_ids / proposal_ids / order refs
fields.reason: string — human-readable resolution reason (required on mutate)

rules: LLM interprets intent only; server emits Events
Mutating Events MUST include law_version and reason
object_ids never include a Subject claiming self as NFT
Sim layer first; chain attest later mirrors event_id
